decisions.scope: Physical and logical surfaces are reused, not rebuilt. Task ownership is unique; integration dependencies do not block independent local implementation.
decisions.devUsable: Real callable library/app/host operation with decoded/persisted actual output and negative tests, restricted to explicitly described local source and rights.
decisions.integratedDevComplete: Full supported source/actor/version/rights/clock/result API with real positive output, negative/restart/client tests and documented limitations; no formal lifecycle, release or deployment claim.
decisions.noRerun: Previously VERIFIED tasks are not selected as implementation work; tests are run only on changed source/dependency/transitive contract/fixtures/toolchain/host profile or if old pass was incomplete/invalid. Never use --rerun-tasks by default.
decisions.externalTests: Do not cache missing rights, volatile provider health, external destination effects or real-host quality results across changed inputs.
decisions.noDuplicatedTaskDefinitions: Only taskIds and stable area delivery steps are stored here; exact task what/how/where/acceptance remain in the source task register.
